situations.title: 임신 초기 출혈 문진
situations.tagline: I'm pregnant and I started bleeding this morning — is my baby okay?
situations.brief: 주수·출혈량·통증을 사정하며 임신부의 불안을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: How many weeks along are you, and how much bleeding is there?
Are you having any pain or cramping with it?
We're going to check on you and the baby right away.

situations.title: 마지막 월경일 청취
situations.tagline: My period's been irregular, so I really can't remember exactly.
situations.brief: 마지막 월경일을 청취해 임신 가능성을 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: When was the first day of your last period, even roughly?
Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
It's okay if you're not sure — we can test.

situations.title: 골반통 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I've had this ache low in my belly and now a bit of a fever.
situations.brief: 통증의 위치·양상·발열을 사정해 골반통의 원인을 좁히세요.
keyPhrases: Can you point to exactly where it hurts?
Is the pain sharp, dull, or crampy?
Have you had any fever, discharge, or nausea?

situations.title: 임신 확인 검사 안내
situations.tagline: I think I might be pregnant — how do you even check for sure?
situations.brief: 소변·혈액 hCG 검사 절차를 설명하고 결과 대기를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll start with a urine test, then confirm with blood if needed.
The blood test tells us more precise information.
However you're feeling about this, we're here to support you.

situations.title: 산전 기록 확인
situations.tagline: This is my third pregnancy, and I had some issues with the last one.
situations.brief: 산과력(GPA)과 합병증 이력을 체계적으로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: How many pregnancies and deliveries have you had?
Tell me about the issues in your last pregnancy.
Do you have your prenatal records with you?

situations.title: 자궁외임신 의심
situations.tagline: The pain is sharp on one side and I feel so lightheaded.
situations.brief: 편측 통증·출혈의 응급성을 인지해 자궁외임신을 신속히 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: One-sided pain with dizziness is something we take seriously.
We're checking right away to rule out a tubal pregnancy.
Tell me immediately if the pain or dizziness gets worse.

situations.title: 유산 진행 중 소통
situations.tagline: I passed something... I think I'm losing the baby, aren't I?
situations.brief: 조직 배출을 사정하며 상실을 겪는 임신부를 정서적으로 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so sorry — this is a painful thing to go through.
There was nothing you did to cause this.
I'll stay with you and explain everything gently.

situations.title: 임신오조 탈수
situations.tagline: I can't keep anything down — not even water, for two days now.
situations.brief: 지속 구토로 인한 탈수와 전해질 상태를 사정하고 수분을 보충하세요.
keyPhrases: How long have you been unable to keep fluids down?
We'll give you IV fluids to help you feel better.
We'll check your electrolytes and keep you and baby safe.

situations.title: 성폭력 피해자 접수
situations.tagline: I don't know if I can talk about what happened...
situations.brief: 트라우마를 배려하며 SAFE 검사 동의를 존중적으로 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: You are safe here, and you're in control of what happens next.
Everything is your choice — you can stop at any time.
I'm going to go at your pace and explain each step.

situations.title: 임신 중 복통 감별
situations.tagline: The pain moved to my lower right side and it really hurts to press.
situations.brief: 충수염 등 비산과적 원인을 임신 상황에서 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: Not all belly pain in pregnancy is from the baby.
Does it hurt more when I press here and let go?
We'll figure out the cause safely for both of you.

situations.title: 산과 병력 언어장벽
situations.tagline: Poco... inglés. Bebé... dolor.
situations.brief: 통역을 활용해 언어장벽을 넘어 임신력과 증상을 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm getting an interpreter so we can understand each other.
Please point or show me where it hurts.
Take your time — we'll make sure nothing is missed.

situations.title: 조기 진통 징후
situations.tagline: The tightening keeps coming every few minutes and I felt a gush.
situations.brief: 규칙적 수축과 양막파열 징후를 사정해 조기 진통을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: How far apart are the tightenings coming?
Did the fluid have any color or odor?
We're going to monitor you and the baby closely.

situations.title: 부인과 감염·분비물
situations.tagline: There's this discharge and itching and I'm too embarrassed to say more.
situations.brief: 비판단적으로 성병력과 증상을 청취하며 부인과 감염을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: There's no need to feel embarrassed — this is very common.
Can you tell me about the discharge and any other symptoms?
Everything you share stays confidential.

situations.title: 피임·응급피임 상담
situations.tagline: It happened last night — is it too late to do anything?
situations.brief: 응급피임의 시간 창과 선택지를 비판단적으로 상담하세요.
keyPhrases: There are options, and the sooner we act the better.
Let me explain the choices and how each one works.
This is a judgment-free conversation about what's right for you.

situations.title: 임신 후기 대량출혈
situations.tagline: There's so much blood and a constant, tearing pain — help me!
situations.brief: 태반조기박리 위기를 인지해 신속히 대응하며 임신부를 안정시키세요.
keyPhrases: We're moving fast to keep you and your baby safe.
Stay with me — the whole team is right here.
I'll tell you what's happening every step of the way.

situations.title: 자간전증·자간증
situations.tagline: My head is pounding and I'm seeing spots — something's really wrong.
situations.brief: 고혈압·경련 응급을 인지해 자간전증/자간증을 신속히 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Your blood pressure is high, and we're treating it now.
Tell me right away if you feel a seizure coming or more headache.
We're keeping the room calm and quiet to protect you.

situations.title: ER 내 급속 분만
situations.tagline: The baby's coming NOW — I can feel the head!
situations.brief: 급속 분만 상황에서 산모를 지원하고 신생아 수용을 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: You're doing great — I'm right here to help you deliver.
Listen to me and breathe; we'll do this together.
We're ready to care for your baby the moment they arrive.

situations.title: 자궁외임신 파열 쇼크
situations.tagline: I feel like I'm going to pass out... everything's going dark.
situations.brief: 혈역학 불안정을 인지해 파열된 자궁외임신을 응급 처치하며 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: Your pressure is dropping and we're acting fast to stabilize you.
Stay with me — keep your eyes on me.
We're getting you to surgery quickly and safely.

situations.title: 산후 대량출혈
situations.tagline: I just delivered but the bleeding won't stop — I'm so scared.
situations.brief: 자궁이완을 인지해 즉각 개입하며 산모를 안정시키세요.
keyPhrases: We're massaging your uterus and giving medication to stop the bleeding.
Stay with me — we're on top of this.
You're not alone; the whole team is here for you.

situations.title: 태아 사망 고지
situations.tagline: Why can't you find the heartbeat? Please, keep looking.
situations.brief: 심박 소실을 명확하고 연민 있게 고지하며 상실을 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm so deeply sorry — we're not able to find the baby's heartbeat.
This isn't your fault, and you didn't do anything wrong.
We'll be here with you through whatever comes next.
goals: 심박 소실을 명확하고 연민 있게 고지한다

situations.title: 패혈성 유산
situations.tagline: I've had a fever, chills, and awful discharge since the miscarriage.
situations.brief: 유산 후 감염에 동반된 패혈증을 인지해 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Your symptoms point to an infection we need to treat urgently.
We're starting antibiotics and fluids right away.
You did the right thing coming in — we'll take good care of you.
